# Acebeam — Official Store

> Acebeam designs and manufactures professional LED flashlights, LEP searchlights and LED headlamps for outdoor, tactical, hunting, dive and everyday-carry use. Every light ships with a 10-year warranty and free shipping on orders over $49. Prices and stock on this static prototype are demonstration data.

Confirmed specifications follow the ANSI/PLATO FL1 standard; throw distance equals 2√(peak candela).

## Store

- [Home](https://www.acebeam.com/): featured flashlights, beam technology, FAQ
- [All Products](https://www.acebeam.com/all-products.html): full catalog with price facets and sorting
- [Categories](https://www.acebeam.com/categories.html): High Power, Tactical, LED Headlamps, LEP, Dive, EDC, Batteries & Accessories
- [New Products](https://www.acebeam.com/new-products.html): latest releases
- [Brands & Series](https://www.acebeam.com/brands.html)
- [Search](https://www.acebeam.com/search.html)

## For Automated Visitors
